description: Turns bb's chrome into frosted glass over a soft mesh wallpaper, in light and dark mode. Sidebar, main pane, composer, popovers, dialogs, and cards become translucent sheets that keep text readable through the tint. No surface draws a border or shadow, so the window reads as one continuous material divided by tone alone. Works in the browser and the desktop app; requires backdrop-filter support and falls back to a solid palette without it.
